# Master Beauty Academy

> Where Artistry Meets Excellence — a 30-day Professional Beautician Course in Hubli & Belagavi covering beauty, grooming, skincare, hair care, wellness, salon management, and professional makeup. ₹40,000 all-inclusive.

## Overview
Master Beauty Academy is co-founded by **Anilkumar Sakhe** (Co-Founder & CEO, 15+ years in business development) and **Priyanka Sakhe** (Co-Founder, recipient of the Award of Excellence in Makeup from LAPT London and Best Makeup Artist at the Global Fame Awards 2023, presented by Sonu Sood).

Founded in 2015. 1,000+ beauty professionals trained across India and abroad. Many graduates now earn up to ₹1 lakh per month running their own salons.

## Course — Professional Beautician Course
- **Duration**: 30 days (intensive, hands-on)
- **Fee**: ₹40,000 all-inclusive (interest-free 2/3-month EMI available)
- **Categories**: 9 — Beauty & Grooming · Facial Treatments (incl. HydraFacial) · Hand & Foot Care · Wellness & Massage · Hair Care · Hair Cutting & Styling · Salon Management · Basic Makeup Technician · Advanced Hair Treatments (smoothening, hair botox)
- **Certification**: Founder-signed Professional Beautician Certificate
- **Cities**: Hubli · Belagavi

## Locations
